content.short: Aria is a decentralized protocol for tokenizing Intellectual Property (IP) assets, specifically music royalties.
content.description: Aria is a pioneering Real-World Asset (RWA) protocol built on the Story Protocol ecosystem, designed to democratize ownership of Intellectual Property. The platform tokenizes revenue-generating assets like music royalties, allowing retail investors to own fractional shares of iconic cultural works. By bridging the gap between traditional IP rights and decentralized finance, Aria enables creators to unlock liquidity while providing the community with direct access to alternative asset classes. Its innovative architecture ensures transparent revenue distribution and verifiable ownership of IP-backed tokens, such as $ARIAIP.
content.meta: Aria tokenizes Intellectual Property and music royalties, offering fractional ownership of assets. Discover Aria and other Real World Asset Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
